title: Herb Garden
shortDescription: Fragrant paths wind between neatly labelled beds.
longDescription:
Mint, thyme, and sage crowd raised beds edged with old roof tiles. A bumblebee bumps into a lavender head, considers the matter, and tries again with more dignity.
Groundskeeper Tansy kneels beside a row of slate labels, her apron full of twine. The greenhouse glints to the north, while rosemary leads the path west toward the Quiet Chapel.

fixtures.name: Groundskeeper Tansy
fixtures.lookDescription: A broad badger in muddy boots and a scarred leather apron, seed pouches at her belt. Try talk tansy.
fixtures.examineDescription: Tansy's claws are dark with soil and her apron has been patched with whatever leather would hold. She sorts seeds by smell, and she notices which plants you crush before she notices your manners.
fixtures.dialogue: "The trick with living things is to look before you fix." Tansy brushes soil from a slate label. "Especially if your first idea is more water. My first idea used to be more water. We lost a cactus that way."

fixtures.name: Slate Labels
fixtures.examineDescription: Tansy's careful lettering names each plant and what it needs. Moonmint: damp soil, free drainage, patient attention. Rosemary: sun and restraint. Mint: a pot of its own, unless you wish to have a garden consisting entirely of mint.
